title: a stranger initialises a state on the VICTIM's mint before the victim does (he never signed anything, isn't the mint authority)
note: attacker is now owners_authority/admin/president of the state tied to the victim's coin (decision 2026-09-30: `initialize` stays open)

title: …and `initialize` accepted degenerate parameters without any bounds check
note: voting period 1s, timelock 0s, quorums 0/0/0 bps, proposal threshold 0 bps, president payroll 10000 bps/day (=100% per day), finance limit 10000 bps/day

title: the real owner then tries to initialise his own coin
note: FAILS (the Config PDA for that mint is taken forever) → the coin can never get a legitimate state; a new mint is needed

title: griefing: attacker pre-creates the future treasury account (a 0.002 SOL ATA) → the owner's initialize fails
note: initialize FAILED for the real owner (the associated-token program refuses to re-create the existing account: "Provided owner is not allowed")

title: governance mint with a hidden PermanentDelegate (can move/burn ANY holder's coins, incl. the pool vault) is accepted by initialize
note: no check of mint extensions / authorities: users must verify the mint themselves

title: owner registers a pool with a 0.25% fee (instead of 5%): register_pool only checks pair + 'fee only in B', not the fee level
note: accepted — 'constant 5%' is a launch-procedure promise, not something the contract enforces (the fee schedule/level is not read; decision 2026-09-30: stays as it is)
